comments.author: @franzfanz
comments.text:
To explain this to our American friends. Twenty 20 is a format of cricket played over 20 overs. An over is a set of six legal deliveries. Think of deliveries as pitches in baseball. There are rules about what constitutes a legal delivery that we won't get into. This format results in a game of 120 deliveries for each team. One team bats and sets a total, the other team then has to beat that score. Simple, right? Well, in this case, both teams finished on the same score. That means that a Super Over decides the match. This is exactly what it sounds like, a team has one over to score as much as it can. The other team then has to try and beat it. 

As for why the US hosted this match; they cohosted the tournament with the West Indies, who are a group of Caribbean nations that play as one team.
